review_evidence: README describes this as a staging formalization of the hat/spectre aperiodic-monotile results and their general tiling-theory prerequisites intended for Mathlib/archive contribution.

Direct inspection of AM/Mathlib/Combinatorics/Tiling/Periodic.lean found definitions of strongly/weakly periodic tilings and weakly/strongly aperiodic protosets, with substantial theorem development and literature references.

The 11 primary Lean files comprise tiling functions, tilesets, cardinality, isohedral/periodicity theory, and import surfaces; no build-only Lean file or other lossless repository-local primary exclusion was found.
summary: Retain the aperiodic-monotile and tiling-theory formalization in full.
